data.content_ref: inline:SRC_001 asserts a contradiction between SRC_002 and SRC_004, but its own 'refuted if' clause reveals that the apparent disagreement collapses into identity: both sources silently assume the same background conditions (thermal mass and evapotranspiration differences dominate under the same overturn/counterconditions) and differ only in rhetorical emphasis. By the target's own admission, an empirical-scope identity between the two conditions means there is no substantive contradiction—only a difference in framing. A predicate that explicitly disproves its own named relation does not state a substantive relation (contradiction); it states a non-relation dressed as one. The target thus fails the problem's standard, which requires proposing a substantive relation, because the named contradiction is refuted a priori by the target's own premise.
